svg.text: 18 tables + 1 derived view · grouped per M1-schema-reference.md + M1b-Core-Tenancy-Schema.md · arrows point FK → referenced PK

Arrows: FK → referenced PK, colored by the table holding the foreign key (see its "FK ..." row for the column name) · dashed arrow = the view reads the table, not a real FK · dashed box = derived view, not a stored table · PK/FK tags shown inline · types abbreviated (tsz = timestamptz)

v2.0.0 changes from v1.1.0: added roles / permissions / role_permissions; memberships.role → memberships.role_id; members.platform_role dropped (folded into memberships); store_invitations gained organization_id for org-scoped invites.
